title: Seven Rivers One Sea: Confluence Atlas
subtitle: A fictional field atlas of seven imagined waterways joining a common shore.

sections.mission: This fictional project explores seven imagined waterways joining a common shore. All settings and observations are invented. It links each illustration to field notes so readers can compare the evidence and follow the sequence.
sections.challenge: How can small route changes be followed as fictional rivers meet? A single illustration cannot explain the order of observations or why one interpretation was chosen. Each entry therefore records its place in the sequence, describes what changed, and keeps gaps in the imagined evidence visible.
approach: Draw each tributary separately, then overlay the paths on a shared map.
impact: Show how many observations can be gathered into one coherent atlas.

research.focus: Exploring the imagined themes of Seven Rivers One Sea: Confluence Atlas in a fictional research record. Locations and measurements remain imaginary.
